test_title: PYST 9: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 01 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Choose the option that will replace the error highlighted in bold.**
She could not support** the temptation to open the letter and read it.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Resist**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The sentence uses the phrase "**could not support the temptation**," which is incorrect in this context as "support" does not collocate with "temptation." 
 
• The correct verb to use here is "**resist**," which means to withstand or fight against something, such as a temptation.
